responseText:
Oh, these are nice. The stalks are cleanly cut. No knots, well-hewn rock. Good work, and you stayed clear of those Minotaur, I hope. Well done! 

I'm convinced you can scrape together crafting resources, refining them will take a bit more work, though - and the Artisans' Outposts are kind of a long haul from here.

Go on over and see the Ramkeepers, tell one of them I sent you over and they'll set you up with a Hammerhoof to make the trek a bit easier on you.
